criteria.criterion: `vloop config set agent.review copilot` and `vloop config set model.review gpt-5.6-terra` both exit 0; `vloop config get agent.review` then prints `copilot`, and with `--json` `{"key":"agent.review","value":"copilot","source":"file"}`.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go: agent.review uses reviewAgents (claude, copilot); config_test.go TestAgentKeys sets copilot and reads it back with source file; model.review is free-form.

criteria.criterion: agent.review accepts exactly claude and copilot: another value is refused by config set (exit 2, naming copilot among the valid values) and is a source error from the environment (exit 1); VLOOP_AGENT_REVIEW=copilot reads with source env.

criteria.evidence: config.go key {Num, MinOpen}; TestCopilotCreditKey covers default, 0/0.0/-1/abc refused on set with the file unchanged and as SourceError naming the env var, env and file overrides; cli config_test.go list outputs include the line.

criteria.criterion: cmd/vloop/run_harness_test.go gains a stub copilot beside the stub claude, following its pattern: it logs each argument on its own line, its working directory and environment, answers --version, and for `-p "/vloop:review <task>"` plays a per-test script and prints JSON Lines (assistant.turn_start, session.usage_checkpoint with data.totalNanoAiu, a result event with exitCode and usage.sessionDurationMs). The stub claude, argv.log and every existing harness test are unchanged.
criteria.evidence: runCopilotStubSource in run_harness_test.go with copilot.log, copilotScript, and TestRunHarnessCopilot asserting events, log content and that argv.log stays empty; the stub claude source is untouched (diff only adds).
